<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8"/>
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"/>
<title>Kylie Cosmetics</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bebas+Neue&family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,400;1,400&family=DM+Sans:wght@300;400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{
  --blush:#F0D6D6; --blush-d:#DDB8B8;
  --cream:#FEF5F5; --warm:#FAF0F0;
  --mauve:#C4847A; --dmauve:#9A5C54;
  --ink:#2E2020;   --muted:#8A7070;
  --nw:64px;       --no:272px;
  --brand:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;
  --serif:'Playfair Display',serif;
  --body:'DM Sans',sans-serif;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0;}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
body{font-family:var(--body);background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink);overflow-x:hidden;}
a{text-decoration:none;color:inherit;cursor:pointer;}
img{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;}
.lbl{font-size:8px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mauve);display:block;margin-bottom:.85rem;}

/* ── LOGO HEADER ── */
.lhd{
  position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:700;height:70px;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#FFF0F2 0%,#FAE4E8 45%,#F5D8DC 100%);
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(196,132,122,.13);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
}
.lhd-center{text-align:center;}
.lhd-logo{font-family:var(--brand);font-size:27px;letter-spacing:.26em;color:#2E1C18;display:block;}
.lhd-sub{font-size:7px;letter-spacing:.28em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);display:block;margin-top:3px;}
.lhd-utils{position:absolute;right:1.75rem;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);display:flex;gap:.95rem;}
.lhd-ico{opacity:.44;cursor:pointer;transition:opacity .2s;display:flex;}.lhd-ico:hover{opacity:1;}
.lhd-ico svg{width:17px;height:17px;stroke:var(--ink);fill:none;stroke-width:1.4;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;}

/* ── ANNOUNCE BAR ── */
.ann{
  position:fixed;top:70px;left:0;right:0;z-index:690;
  background:#F0D0D4;text-align:center;
  font-size:9.5px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.07em;color:var(--ink);
  padding:9px 1rem;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(180,140,140,.15);
}

/* ── SIDEBAR ── */
.snav{
  position:fixed;left:0;z-index:600;
  width:var(--nw);background:#fff;
  border-right:1px solid rgba(196,132,122,.09);
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;
  transition:width .35s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);overflow:hidden;
}
.snav.open{width:var(--no);}
.sntog{
  height:50px;min-height:50px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  cursor:pointer;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(196,132,122,.07);flex-shrink:0;transition:background .2s;
}
.sntog:hover{background:rgba(240,180,185,.07);}
.sntog svg{width:18px;height:18px;stroke:var(--ink);fill:none;stroke-width:1.5;stroke-linecap:round;}
.snlinks{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;overflow-x:hidden;padding:.6rem 0;scrollbar-width:none;}
.snlinks::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none;}
.sncat{
  font-size:7px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.32em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:#B8A0A0;padding:.5rem 1.35rem .22rem;display:block;white-space:nowrap;
  opacity:0;transition:opacity .12s;
}
.snav.open .sncat{opacity:1;transition:opacity .2s .1s;}
.snlnk{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.62rem;padding:.48rem 1.35rem;
  color:var(--ink);opacity:.65;white-space:nowrap;
  transition:opacity .2s,background .2s,padding-left .18s;
}
.snlnk:hover{opacity:1;background:rgba(240,180,185,.09);padding-left:1.6rem;}
.snlnk.active{opacity:1;color:#B8909A;}
.snic{
  width:32px;height:32px;min-width:32px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  border-radius:50%;background:rgba(242,196,196,.14);flex-shrink:0;
}
.snic svg{width:14px;height:14px;stroke:var(--dmauve);fill:none;stroke-width:1.5;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;}
.snlbl{font-size:11.5px;opacity:0;transition:opacity .12s;white-space:nowrap;}
.snav.open .snlbl{opacity:1;transition:opacity .2s .1s;}
.sndiv{height:1px;background:rgba(196,132,122,.07);margin:.45rem 1.35rem;}
.snft{padding:.6rem 0 .8rem;border-top:1px solid rgba(180,150,150,.07);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:.45rem;flex-shrink:0;}
.snctaw{width:100%;padding:0 .9rem .2rem;opacity:0;transition:opacity .12s;}
.snav.open .snctaw{opacity:1;transition:opacity .2s .1s;}
.sncta{display:block;text-align:center;background:#D4A8B0;color:#fff;font-size:7.5px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:10px;border-radius:4px;transition:background .2s;}
.sncta:hover{background:#C0909A;}
.snftico{display:flex;gap:.3rem;}
.sfic{width:36px;height:36px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border-radius:8px;opacity:.4;cursor:pointer;transition:opacity .2s,background .2s;}
.sfic:hover{opacity:1;background:rgba(242,196,196,.12);}
.sfic svg{width:16px;height:16px;stroke:var(--ink);fill:none;stroke-width:1.5;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;}

/* ── PAGE WRAPPER ── */
.pw{margin-left:var(--nw);transition:margin-left .35s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);}
body.nav-open .pw{margin-left:var(--no);}

/* ── REVEAL ANIMATION ── */
.rev{opacity:0;transform:translateY(22px);transition:opacity .7s ease,transform .7s ease;}
.rev.on{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0);}
.d1{transition-delay:.1s}.d2{transition-delay:.2s}.d3{transition-delay:.3s}

/* ── HERO ── */
.hero{
  position:relative;height:calc(100vh - 108px);min-height:500px;max-height:850px;
  overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;
}
/* fallback gradient shown when no image */
.hero-bg{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(148deg,#FFF0F2 0%,#FAE4E8 35%,#F0D4DA 65%,#E4C4CC 100%);}
.hero-bg img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;}
.hero-veil{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(to bottom,rgba(14,3,1,.72) 0%,rgba(14,3,1,.12) 55%,transparent 100%);}
.hero-eyebrow{position:absolute;top:2rem;left:2.5rem;font-size:8px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,.55);}
.hero-content{position:relative;z-index:2;padding:0 2.5rem 3.5rem;}
.hero-h1{font-family:var(--brand);font-size:clamp(3rem,5.8vw,5rem);line-height:.92;color:#fff;letter-spacing:.05em;margin-bottom:2rem;}
.hero-h1 em{font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;font-size:.9em;letter-spacing:0;}
.hero-row{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;gap:1.5rem;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.hero-tags{display:flex;gap:.52rem;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.htag{font-size:8px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:7px 14px;border-radius:100px;border:1px solid rgba(180,140,150,.35);color:rgba(80,55,55,.75);cursor:pointer;transition:background .2s,border-color .2s,color .2s;}
.htag:hover{background:rgba(212,168,176,.15);border-color:rgba(180,140,150,.6);color:#4A3030;}
.htag.filled{background:#D4A8B0;border-color:#D4A8B0;color:#fff;}
.hero-sub{font-size:11px;color:rgba(90,62,62,.58);max-width:155px;line-height:1.75;text-align:right;}

/* ── MARQUEE ── */
.mq{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#FEFDFB 0%,#FAF5F6 50%,#F5EEF0 100%);padding:10px 0;overflow:hidden;}
.mq-t{display:flex;animation:mqscroll 26s linear infinite;white-space:nowrap;}
.mq-t span{font-size:8px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(90,62,62,.6);padding:0 2rem;}
.mq-t .dot{color:#B8909A;}
@keyframes mqscroll{from{transform:translateX(0)}to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}

/* ── BRAND ICONS STRIP ── */

/* ── SHADE FINDER (editorial 2-col) ── */
.editorial{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;min-height:520px;background:#fff;border-top:1px solid rgba(200,160,165,.1);}
.ed-text{background:#fff;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;padding:4rem 3.5rem;order:1;}
.ed-h2{font-family:var(--brand);font-size:clamp(2.2rem,4vw,3.4rem);line-height:.9;letter-spacing:.04em;margin-bottom:1rem;color:var(--mauve);}
.ed-h2 em{font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;font-size:.84em;letter-spacing:0;color:var(--mauve);}
.ed-p{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);max-width:340px;line-height:1.9;margin-bottom:1.8rem;}
.ed-img{position:relative;overflow:hidden;min-height:460px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#FBF0F0 0%,#F5E4E4 100%);order:2;}
.ed-img img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:top center;mix-blend-mode:multiply;}
.ed-placeholder{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#FBF0F0 0%,#F0DEDE 100%);}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;font-size:8.5px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:11px 26px;border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .2s,box-shadow .2s;}
.btn-solid{background:#C8A0A8;color:#fff;}.btn-solid:hover{background:#B8909A;transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(184,144,154,.28);}
.btn-outline{background:transparent;color:#5A3E3E;border:1px solid rgba(180,140,150,.45);letter-spacing:.08em;font-size:11px;padding:10px 22px;}
.btn-outline:hover{background:#C8A0A8;border-color:#C8A0A8;color:#fff;}
.btn-blush{background:transparent;color:#5A3E3E;border:1px solid rgba(180,140,150,.45);}.btn-blush:hover{background:#C8A0A8;border-color:#C8A0A8;color:#fff;transform:translateY(-1px);}

/* ── CATEGORIES ── */
.cats{padding:4.5rem 2.5rem;background:#FDF0F0;}
.sec-hd{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;margin-bottom:2rem;}
.sec-hd h2{font-family:var(--brand);font-size:clamp(1.8rem,3.4vw,2.7rem);letter-spacing:.07em;}
.sec-hd h2 em{font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;font-size:.86em;letter-spacing:0;}
.sec-hd a{font-size:8px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mauve);transition:color .2s;}
.sec-hd a:hover{color:var(--dmauve);}
.cat-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:1rem;}
.cat-card{background:#fff;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .28s,box-shadow .28s;}
.cat-card:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);box-shadow:0 16px 36px rgba(154,92,84,.11);}
/* category thumbnail — holds image OR fallback */
.cat-thumb{width:100%;aspect-ratio:1;position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
.cat-thumb img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;}
.cat-fallback{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.6rem;}
.cat-fallback svg{width:38px;height:38px;stroke:var(--mauve);fill:none;stroke-width:1;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;opacity:.45;}
.cat-fallback span{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(26,26,26,.18);}
.cat-body{padding:.8rem 1rem 1rem;}
.cat-body h3{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:.92rem;font-style:italic;margin-bottom:.18rem;}
.cat-body p{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.6;}

/* ── LAUNCH DARK ── */
.launch{background:#FDFAFA;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;min-height:500px;border-top:1px solid rgba(210,170,175,.12);}
.launch-text{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;padding:4rem 3.5rem;order:1;}
.launch-text .lbl{color:var(--mauve);}
.launch-h2{font-family:var(--brand);font-size:clamp(2.4rem,4.5vw,3.8rem);letter-spacing:.04em;color:var(--ink);line-height:.9;margin-bottom:1.2rem;}
.launch-h2 em{font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;font-size:.82em;letter-spacing:0;color:var(--mauve);}
.launch-p{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);max-width:320px;line-height:1.9;margin-bottom:.85rem;}
.launch-meta{display:flex;gap:.85rem;font-size:8px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);opacity:.6;margin-bottom:2rem;}
.launch-img{position:relative;overflow:hidden;min-height:440px;background:#0a0608;order:2;}
.launch-img img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:right center;}
.launch-fallback{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.75rem;}
.launch-fallback svg{width:50px;height:50px;stroke:rgba(180,120,140,.25);fill:none;stroke-width:.9;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;}

/* ── BESTSELLERS ── */
.best{padding:4.5rem 2.5rem;background:#FEF5F5;}
.pscroll{display:flex;gap:1.15rem;overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:.6rem;scrollbar-width:none;margin-top:1.75rem;}
.pscroll::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none;}
.prod{flex:0 0 155px;cursor:pointer;}
/* product image or fallback */
.prod-img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:3/4;border-radius:12px;margin-bottom:.65rem;position:relative;overflow:hidden;transition:transform .28s;}
.prod:hover .prod-img{transform:scale(1.04);}
.prod-img img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center;mix-blend-mode:multiply;}
.prod-fallback{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.5rem;}
.prod-fallback svg{width:30px;height:30px;stroke:var(--mauve);fill:none;stroke-width:1.1;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;opacity:.35;}
.pname{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:.82rem;font-style:italic;margin-bottom:.2rem;line-height:1.3;}
.pprice{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--muted);}

/* ── QUOTE ── */
.quote-sec{padding:5.5rem 2.5rem;background:#FAE8EA;text-align:center;}
.quote-sec blockquote{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:clamp(1.1rem,2.1vw,1.7rem);font-style:italic;max-width:600px;margin:0 auto 1.15rem;line-height:1.5;color:var(--ink);}
.quote-sec cite{font-size:8px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.26em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dmauve);font-style:normal;}

/* ── FOOTER ── */
.foot{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#FEFDFB 0%,#FAF5F6 55%,#F5EEF0 100%);padding:4.5rem 2.5rem 2rem;color:rgba(90,62,62,.75);}
.foot-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.5fr 1fr 1fr 1.4fr;gap:2.5rem;padding-bottom:2.5rem;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(180,140,148,.12);margin-bottom:1.75rem;}
.fc{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.5rem;}
.f-brand{font-family:var(--brand);font-size:19px;letter-spacing:.14em;color:#5A3E3E;line-height:1;margin-bottom:.2rem;}
.f-tagline{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:11px;font-style:italic;color:rgba(90,62,62,.52);}
.f-cat{font-size:7.5px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.24em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(90,62,62,.62);margin-bottom:.26rem;}
.fc a{font-size:11.5px;color:rgba(90,62,62,.65);transition:color .2s;}.fc a:hover{color:#5A3E3E;}
.email-row{display:flex;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(180,140,148,.15);margin-bottom:.9rem;}
.email-row input{background:none;border:none;outline:none;font-family:var(--body);font-size:11.5px;color:#5A3E3E;flex:1;padding:.4rem 0;}
.email-row input::placeholder{color:rgba(90,62,62,.32);}
.email-row button{background:none;border:none;color:rgba(180,140,150,.55);font-size:15px;cursor:pointer;transition:color .2s;}.email-row button:hover{color:#5A3E3E;}
.socials{display:flex;gap:.72rem;}
.socials a{font-size:8px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(90,62,62,.52);transition:color .2s;}.socials a:hover{color:#5A3E3E;}
.foot-bot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:9.5px;color:rgba(90,62,62,.44);}

/* ── PRESS STRIP ── */
.press-strip{
  background:#fff;
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(220,170,175,.14);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  gap:2rem;padding:1.4rem 2.5rem;flex-wrap:wrap;
}
.press-lbl{
  font-size:7px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.32em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:#C4909A;white-space:nowrap;flex-shrink:0;
}
.press-logos{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1.1rem;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;}
.press-name{
  font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;
  font-size:1.05rem;color:#C0A0A8;
  letter-spacing:.01em;opacity:.7;
  transition:opacity .2s;cursor:default;
}
.press-name:hover{opacity:1;}
.press-dot{color:#DDB8BE;font-size:.7rem;}
.swnote{font-size:9.5px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:1.6rem;}
.swatches{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-bottom:.75rem;}
.sw{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .25s,box-shadow .25s;}
.sw:hover{transform:scale(1.15);box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.15);}

/* ── HERO CENTER IMAGE ── */
.hero-center-img{
  position:absolute;
  bottom:0;
  left:50%;
  transform:translateX(-50%);
  width:58%;
  max-width:580px;
  z-index:1;
  pointer-events:none;
}
.hero-center-img img{
  width:100%;
  height:auto;
  display:block;
  mix-blend-mode:multiply;
  opacity:.92;
  -webkit-mask-image:
    linear-gradient(to bottom, black 0%, black 72%, transparent 100%),
    linear-gradient(to right, transparent 0%, black 10%, black 90%, transparent 100%);
  -webkit-mask-composite: destination-in;
  mask-image:
    linear-gradient(to bottom, black 0%, black 72%, transparent 100%),
    linear-gradient(to right, transparent 0%, black 10%, black 90%, transparent 100%);
  mask-composite: intersect;
}

.launch-img-fade{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(to right,transparent 55%,#FDFAFA 100%);pointer-events:none;z-index:2;}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<header class="lhd" id="lhd">
  <div class="lhd-center">
    <span class="lhd-logo">KYLIE COSMETICS</span>
    <span class="lhd-sub">by Kylie Jenner</span>
  </div>
  <div class="lhd-utils">
    <span class="lhd-ico"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path d="M21 21l-4.35-4.35"/></svg></span>
    <span class="lhd-ico"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M20 21v-2a4 4 0 00-4-4H8a4 4 0 00-4 4v2"/><circle cx="12" cy="7" r="4"/></svg></span>
    <span class="lhd-ico"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M6 2L3 6v14a2 2 0 002 2h14a2 2 0 002-2V6l-3-4z"/><line x1="3" y1="6" x2="21" y2="6"/><path d="M16 10a4 4 0 01-8 0"/></svg></span>
  </div>
</header>

<div class="ann" id="ann">
  free makeup bag 🩷 with any cosmic purchase &nbsp;·&nbsp; free shipping over ₹4000 &nbsp;·&nbsp; join kylie rewards
</div>

<aside class="snav" id="snav">
  <div class="sntog" id="sntog">
    <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><line x1="3" y1="6" x2="21" y2="6"/><line x1="3" y1="12" x2="21" y2="12"/><line x1="3" y1="18" x2="21" y2="18"/></svg>
  </div>
  <nav class="snlinks">
    <span class="sncat">Shop</span>
    <a class="snlnk" href="#"><span class="snic"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 2l2 6h6l-5 3.6 1.9 5.9L12 14l-4.9 3.5 1.9-5.9L4 8h6z"/></svg></span><span class="snlbl">New Arrivals</span></a>
    <a class="snlnk" href="#"><span class="snic"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><polygon points="12 2 15.1 8.3 22 9.3 17 14.1 18.2 21 12 17.8 5.8 21 7 14.1 2 9.3 8.9 8.3 12 2"/></svg></span><span class="snlbl">Best Sellers</span></a>

<script>
function setNav() {
  var h = document.getElementById('lhd').offsetHeight;
  var a = document.getElementById('ann').offsetHeight;
  var nav = document.getElementById('snav');
  var pw = document.getElementById('pw');
  nav.style.top = (h + a) + 'px';
  nav.style.bottom = '0';
  pw.style.paddingTop = (h + a) + 'px';
}
setNav();
window.addEventListener('resize', setNav);

document.getElementById('sntog').addEventListener('click', function() {
  var open = document.getElementById('snav').classList.toggle('open');
  document.body.classList.toggle('nav-open', open);
});

var io = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries) {
  entries.forEach(function(e) {
    if (e.isIntersecting) { e.target.classList.add('on'); io.unobserve(e.target); }
  });
}, { threshold: 0.07 });
document.querySelectorAll('.rev').forEach(function(el) { io.observe(el); });

/* Hide fallback icons when image loads successfully */
document.querySelectorAll('.prod-img img, .cat-thumb img, .launch-img img').forEach(function(img) {
  if (img.src && img.src !== window.location.href) {
    img.removeAttribute('style');
    var fallback = img.nextElementSibling;
    if (fallback) fallback.style.display = 'none';
  }
});
</script>
